castlenavigation: Name of the special page listing every Castle room and its exits.
castlenavigation-totals: Totals above the room table. $1 rooms in the navigation map, $2 rooms having at least one destination that does not exist, $3 such destinations in total, $4 rooms with no wiki page of their own.
castlenavigation-col-room: Table column heading: the room's key in the navigation map.
castlenavigation-col-page: Table column heading: whether a wiki page with the room's title exists.
castlenavigation-col-exits: Table column heading: how many destinations the room links to.
castlenavigation-col-broken: Table column heading: how many of those destinations do not exist.
castlenavigation-col-status: Table column heading: plain-language summary of the room's health.
castlenavigation-col-slot: Table column heading: the numbered placeholder ({{[[1]]}}, {{[[2]]}} ...) this destination fills in the room's prose.
castlenavigation-col-destination: Table column heading: the page title this exit links to.
castlenavigation-col-shownas: Table column heading: the link's display text, when it differs from the page title.
castlenavigation-status-ok: Shown when every destination of a room exists.
castlenavigation-status-nopage: Shown when the navigation map has an entry but no wiki page carries that title.
castlenavigation-status-brokentargets: Label before a list of destinations that do not exist. Each is rendered as a red link that opens the create-page form.
castlenavigation-prose-heading: Heading above the room's exit sentence, with destinations replaced by numbered placeholders.
castlenavigation-destinations-heading: Heading above the table of destinations that fill the room's placeholders.
castlenavigation-noexits: Shown on a room's page when it links nowhere.
castlenavigation-noroom: Error shown when the requested room is not in the navigation map. $1 is the requested room key.
castlenavigation-backtoindex: Link text returning to the list of all rooms.
castlenavigation-noentry-heading: Heading above the list of pages that render a navigation tag but have no entry in the map.
castlenavigation-noentry-empty: Shown when that list is empty. Notes that the list is populated as pages are parsed, so an empty list is not proof of completeness.
nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry: {{tracking category name}} Category collecting pages that render a navigation tag with no matching entry in the navigation map.
nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry-desc: {{tracking category desc}} Explains why a page is in the category.
castlenavigation-badtitle: Shown when a destination cannot be parsed as a page title at all, so there is nothing to link to. $1 is the raw target as written in the navigation map.
castlenavigation-field-prose: Label for the textarea holding the room’s exit sentence.
castlenavigation-field-prose-help: Help text under the prose field, explaining the numbered placeholders.
castlenavigation-field-target: Label for a destination field. $1 is the slot number matching the placeholder in the prose.
castlenavigation-field-label: Label for the optional display-text field of a destination. $1 is the slot number.
castlenavigation-field-allowmissing: Checkbox letting the editor save a destination that is not an existing page, e.g. a page they intend to write.
castlenavigation-save: {{Identical|Save}} Submit button for the room editing form.
castlenavigation-error-emptytarget: Error when a destination field was left blank. $1 is the slot number.
castlenavigation-error-unknownslot: Error when the prose references a placeholder with no matching destination. $1 is a comma-separated list like "{5}".
castlenavigation-error-orphanslot: Error when a destination exists but the prose never places it. $1 is a comma-separated list like "{3}".
castlenavigation-error-missingtargets: Lead-in for the save warning, followed by red links to each destination that is not yet a page. Not fatal — the editor may confirm and save.
castlenavigation-save-badpage: Error when the configured data page title cannot be parsed. $1 is that title.
castlenavigation-save-badjson: Error when the navigation data could not be encoded as JSON.
castlenavigation-viewroom: Lead-in shown after a successful save, followed by a link to the room’s own wiki page so the editor can check the result.
castlenavigation-error-missingtargets-hi: Shown after that list of red links, explaining the three ways forward.
